title: VTC — Vetting PCS Binding — Reset — payload
description: A community administrator resets one vetter's hidden-vetting (PCS) identifier binding, because the key behind it is lost. The community accepts a new identifier from that member only once no label the old identifier enrolled under is still live, so the member can never be counted twice.

memberDid.description: The member whose binding is reset.

reason.description: Why, in the administrator's words. Kept in the community's audit record.

Response.title: VTC — Vetting PCS Binding — Reset — response payload
Response.description: The reset as recorded. A repeated reset returns the first one's record.

resetAt.description: When the binding was reset — the first reset, if this one repeats it.

waitingOn.description: The labels the old identifier enrolled under that are still live now. A new identifier is accepted once none is.

open.description: True when `waitingOn` is empty: the member's next enrolment may present a new identifier.
